title: Find the top 5 drivers born between 1980 and 1990 who achieved the fastest
question: Find the top 5 drivers born between 1980 and 1990 who achieved the fastest average lap time across all races held in circuits located in countries where at least one constructor has nationality matching the circuit's country. Return their full names and average lap time in milliseconds.

SELECT
    d.XCL_038,
    d.XCL_039,
    AVG(lt.XCL_048) AS avg_lap_time_ms
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN lapTimes AS lt ON d.XCL_034 = lt.XCL_044
JOIN races AS r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
JOIN circuits AS c ON r.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM constructors AS cons
      WHERE cons.XCL_025 = c.XCL_005
  )
GROUP BY d.XCL_034, d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
ORDER BY avg_lap_time_ms ASC
LIMIT 5
